entries.name: Lao New Year (Pi Mai Lao)
entries.capsule: The traditional Lao new year in mid-April, marked with temple merit-making, water blessings, food, music and community celebrations.
entries.dateRule: Mid-April, usually April 14 to 16, as set each year by the Lao government. Minnesota celebrations are often held on a nearby weekend, sometimes weeks later.

dates.source: Calculated (python-holidays, Laos module); no opened page states the 2026 dates

entries.whatItMarks: The start of the traditional Lao year.
entries.howCelebratedInMinnesota: Long hosted by Lao temples; in 2013 younger leaders brought more than 20 organizations together in Crystal for a community-wide celebration with a pageant (MPR News). In southwestern Minnesota, the Worthington temple community celebrated on a weekend after mid-April at the Brewster American Legion Hall, with free food and Lao music (2015). The United Senior Lao American Association sought a state grant for Lao New Year 2025. No 2026 announcement was found.

entries.name: Lao Artists Heritage Month
entries.capsule: A month recognizing Lao American artists; a Minnesota governor issued a proclamation, and Lao exhibits have opened during it.
entries.dateRule: August, as implied by Sahtu Press describing an August 1 opening as 'during Lao American Artists Heritage Month'. The proclamation's text and year were not found.
